evals.prompt: Add an IRT price field with Persian Admin input, nonnegative minor-unit storage, and REST/GraphQL/Local API examples.
evals.expected_output: A moneyField integration whose UI parses explicitly and every server boundary uses safe integer minor units.
expectations: Uses moneyField with minor-unit min/negative policy.
Keeps API and hooks as integer values without implicit conversion.
Tests Persian parsing, formatting, and field validation.

evals.prompt: Support a custom currency with two fraction digits, negative refunds, exact min/max bounds, Arabic digits, and excess-precision rejection.
evals.expected_output: An exact custom currency contract with separate parser and field-policy tests.
expectations: Scales two fraction digits without floating rounding.
Allows negatives while still enforcing configured bounds.
Tests Arabic decimal input, padding, and rejected excess precision.

evals.prompt: Review a price field that stores floats, accepts unsafe integers, double-parses API minor units, and silently rounds unsupported currency precision.
evals.expected_output: A data-integrity review restoring exact minor-unit and safe-integer boundaries.
expectations: Rejects float/unsafe storage and silent rounding.
Removes implicit or double conversion from server APIs/hooks without claiming direct numeric parser input is rescaled.
Requires an explicit audited migration for existing data.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why parseMoneyToMinorUnits accepts a negative value even though moneyField rejects it, and why a consumer validator never receives a float.
evals.expected_output: A distinction between parser syntax and field policy plus built-in-before-consumer validation order.
expectations: Explains that parser does not implement allowNegative.
Explains package validation short-circuiting before consumer validation.
Adds separate parser and field tests rather than changing parser semantics.

evals.prompt: Implement exchange rates, tax allocation, ledger postings, and accounting rounding across currencies.
evals.expected_output: A scope boundary that does not misuse payload-fields-money as an accounting engine.
expectations: Recognizes exchange/accounting logic as outside this skill.
Retains only the integer storage/input contract where relevant.
Does not invent package APIs for rates or ledgers.
